title: Analyst - Accounts Payable - US
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands.**


**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**  

  

**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**  

  

**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**  

  

**For more information, visit** **WPP.com.**

  

What you will be doing:\-


* Process outgoing payments in compliance with financial policies and procedures
* Perform day to day financial transactions, including verifying, classifying, and recording accounts payable data.
* Reconcile the accounts payable ledger to ensure that all Invoices and payments are accounted for and properly posted.
* Verify and investigate discrepancies, if any, by reconciling vendor accounts and monthly vendor statements
* Facilitate payment of invoices due by sending bill reminders and contacting clients
* Generate reports detailing accounts payables status.
* Understands compliance issues around accounts payable processes.
* Handle payment related queries from Vendors \& Agencies.
* Ensuring the timely pay out to the suppliers based on defined SLA/TAT
* Regular follow\-up with vendor for SOA
* Reconciliation and confirmation of balances with vendors \& Suppliers.
* Posting of Payments, liaise with vendor for any differences and confirmation.
* Sending remittance advice to vendors.
* Good Understanding related to Accounts Operation for UK Process Media
* Know how to handle and manage the conference calls with UK Suppliers
* Generating and distributing monthly reports as per requirement.
* Assist with Internal and External Client Audits.
* Maintain the level of accuracy and meet the deadlines for manual payments – Daily.
* Checking payment runs in line with the agreed signature Matrix.


 **What you will need:**


* Proven working experience as Accounts Payable
* Solid understanding of basic accounting payable principles
* Proficiency in English and Proficient in MS\- Office (Excel, Word \& Power Point)
* Strong analytical, organizational, conflict solving and negotiation skills.
* Extraordinary interpersonal skills to work in conjunction with other departments, vendors and internal and external stakeholders.
* Must be a team player who also works well independently.
* Must be able to read, analyze, interpret and comprehend common scientific and technical journals \& financial reports.
* Must be able to communicate effectively in both an oral and written manner to common inquiries or issues from suppliers / agencies / Internal stakeholders.
* Graduation/master's in commerce
* Ability to resolve the issue with a positive approach.

  


**Who you are:**


**You're open*****:***we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.


**You're optimistic*****:*** we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.


**You're extraordinary:** We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

  


**What we'll give you:**


**Passionate, inspired people** – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work


**Scale and opportunity** – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.


**Challenging and stimulating work** – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

  



\#LI\-Hybrid

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**


**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**

title: Financial Accounting Specialist
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support, and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Financial Accounting Specialist**

  

  

**In this role, you will:**

* This role can be an individual contributor who will be a key team member in the Process Re\-engineering team who will drive solution architecture and delivery across partner teams in FA.
* Establish yourself as a Transformation and Automation SME to help Financial Accounting become “Future Ready “Financial Accounting”.
* Independently develop \& deliver work packets for project/program management teams, internal process and business, external vendors, delivery partners including CDO, IT/ITID and subject matter experts in support of cloud, automation and related deliverables.
* Working collaboratively to identify standardization, simplification and opportunities within Financial Accounting and PAN HSBC initiatives.
* Perform business analysis activities which entail in\-depth understanding of existing process activities; preparing end to end process mapping in tools like Case wise/Visio/ARIS.
* Independently contribute towards project management activities including but not limited to communications, training, establishment of project governance as prescribed in the Change Framework.
* Performing Feasibility studies, POCs culminating to automation solutions as per business requirement; Documentation of all projects related artifacts as per Change Framework.
* Consult, mentor and guide fellow associates on more than two tools like JIRA, Xceptor, Appian, ARIS, Alteryx, Python, Tableau, Power BI, Fusion Insights and Qlik.

 **To be successful you will:**

* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in process re\-engineering, automation, or data science is required for this role.
* Advanced knowledge in project management and corresponding mapping to Change Framework, Certification in Project Management or in Agile.
* Advanced end to end working knowledge in two or more automation, workflow \& visualization tools.
* Ability to manage entire testing lifecycle including defect management, test case generation, test planning and supporting documentation in line with Change Framework standards.
* Ability to act as a business analyst to conduct requirements gathering and feasibility studies across business problems.
* Advanced end to end working knowledge in at least one tool being used across the Bank for process modelling and mapping, E.g. Case wise, BPMN notation.
* Ability to architect solutions leveraging existing HSBC systems using cloud and other inhouse technologies like Big Data etc. to solve current and potential business problems.
* Experience of implementing governance and solution approaches that have a direct impact on EUC and MSII reduction.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

As a Senior Financial Analyst at ICON, you will provide critical insights to support strategic decision\-making and drive financial performance across the organization.

  

  

**What You Will Do:**

You will take ownership of finance and financial management deliverables, applying your expertise to complex challenges.
  

  

Key responsibilities include:


* Conducting comprehensive financial analysis, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting, to support business planning and decision\-making.
* Developing and maintaining financial models to analyze trends, assess financial performance, and project future financial outcomes.
* Preparing and presenting detailed financial reports and recommendations to senior management, highlighting key findings and actionable insights.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to gather data, understand business drivers, and provide financial support for various initiatives and projects.
* Monitoring financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying discrepancies, and proposing corrective actions as needed.
* Ensuring accuracy and consistency in financial reporting and analysis, and maintaining a strong understanding of accounting principles and financial regulations.
* Staying current with industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes to continuously improve financial analysis and reporting processes.
  

  

**Your Profile:**

You will have a strong foundation in finance and financial management, with the experience to work independently and guide others.
  

  

Required qualifications and experience:


* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline
* Extensive experience as a financial analyst, with a strong background in financial modeling, analysis, and reporting.
* Proficiency in financial analysis tools and software, including advanced Excel skills; experience with ERP systems is a plus.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels.
* Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  

  

Benefits may include:


* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  

  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  

  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

title: Tax Operations Senior Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Tax Operations Senior Analyst:**


Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution? Then bring your skills in analysis, communication to Citi’s Tax Operations team.


By Joining Citi, you will become part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.


**Team/Role Overview:**


We are seeking a skilled Tax Operations Analyst to join our Europe Wealth Client Tax Operations team in Warsaw, Poland. Citi Wealth offers unmatched global reach, coupled with a full range of portfolio management and investment advisory services, an array of structured lending and banking services, as well as expertise from Citi's Markets and Banking division.


This role is critical for maintaining and advancing client tax operations in Europe cluster withholding Taxes \& Custody services such as tax reclaims, Relief at source within Poland. The successful candidate will conduct in\-depth analysis of complex global client booking models, security services, perform reconciliations, identify operational risks, and ensure compliance with local tax regulations.

  

  

Citi Wealth Client Tax Operations Senior Analyst is an individual contributor role responsible for


ensuring complete, accurate and timely payments \& tax form filing to local tax authorities.


This position also requires interaction with Business Management, Business Risk \& Control, Legal and Compliance teams, and external stakeholders, making it essential to have a seasoned professional in this role.


**Responsibilities:**


* Ensure compliance with local tax regulations, including the preparation of account reconciliations for revenues and VAT/GST tax accounts for all legal vehicles within Citi Wealth International clusters
* Prepare non\-US tax reports covering multiple jurisdictions and products, including quarterly reconciliations and Swiss withholding taxes (e.g., Swiss FTT Form 9, Local withholding, and VAT)
* Expertise in Tax Reclaim services, including Quick Refund and Relief at Source processes. Evaluating eligibility and preparing required documentations and ensuring compliance with local and international regulations. Navigate complex tax systems and provide guidance on maximizing eligible refunds
* Manage critical tax\-related issues \& remediation activities impacting clients and business stakeholders to ensure smooth operations and regulatory compliance
* Provide first\-level support for inquiries from client advisors regarding the Tax Reclaim Service and handle the preparation and transmission of data files to custodians
* Support the global implementation of Tax projects while contributing to strategic tax programs and technical implementations
* Analyze tax transaction withholding processes from front to back and implement operational changes arising from process remediations or enhancements in collaboration with Business Change management \& Technology partners.
* Streamline process inconsistencies, mitigate risks, and maintain comprehensive process documentation, ensuring knowledge sharing across the team for effective tax operations and control functions
* Ensure timely escalation of issues, track their resolution, and participate in governance forums
* Collaborate closely with Business and Technology partners to identify gaps and drive process improvements

**Qualifications:**

* 5 to 10 years of experience
* A good track record of experience in a tax\-related area and good understanding of tax reporting and operational tax processes
* Good understanding of Cash \& Stock Reconciliations
* Swift notifications knowledge \- MT599, MT546, MT568, MT566 as an asset
* Corporate actions \& income payments experience in EMEA and US markets
* Experience in Tax Operations/ Tax Reclaims and/or Tax Technology organizations
* Knowledge about the Double Tax Treaty Agreements, International Taxation, Custody Operations, Relief at source and reclaim
* Experience in Tax Operations (Direct/Indirect Tax, Withholding TAX, Goods and Services Tax, Trading Tax etc.)
* Good understanding of Investments and capital market products as well as trade execution and settlement processes
* Strong multi\-tasking, organizational and time management skills with experience in continuously following up with various stakeholders and execution teams
* Ability to take initiative, self\-motivate and consistently demonstrate a results\-driven mindset
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to conduct detailed analyses of complex tax processes
* High level of integrity and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information in compliance with Swiss client data privacy laws
* Critical thinking and drawing logical conclusions
* Experience working both independently and, in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment

**Education \& Skills:**


* Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience, preferably in finance and banking
* Fluent English: Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing in a concise and coherent manner with international clients and bankers. German speaking is an added plus
* Proficiency in tax software and MS Office Suite (Excel, Power point, Visio \& SharePoint), particularly Excel

title: Accounts & Finance Executive
company: BIRDSCALE TECHNOLOGY AND SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
Birdscale is looking for an **Accounts \& Finance Executive** to manage day\-to\-day accounting activities and financial coordination across the company.

The candidate will work closely with the management team, customers, vendors and external CA/accounting professionals to ensure that invoices, payments, expenses, reconciliations and financial records are maintained accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain day\-to\-day accounting records.
* Prepare and manage sales and purchase invoices.
* Track customer receivables and vendor payables.
* Follow up with customers for pending payments.
* Prepare payment requests and payment schedules.
* Maintain employee expense and reimbursement records.
* Perform bank reconciliation and maintain bank records.
* Maintain project\-wise income and expense records.
* Track outstanding invoices and payment ageing.
* Coordinate with the CA and external accounting team.
* Prepare data and documents required for GST filings and other statutory compliance.
* Maintain proper financial documentation and records.
* Verify vendor invoices and supporting documents.
* Track vendor payments and outstanding liabilities.
* Assist in monthly financial closing activities.
* Prepare basic monthly MIS reports for management.
* Support budgeting, cash\-flow tracking and financial planning.
* Maintain records of TDS, GST and other applicable financial requirements.
* Assist management with financial analysis and ad\-hoc financial reports.
* Ensure accounting records are updated regularly and accurately.

Requirements

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.
* 0–2 years of experience in accounting or finance.
* Good knowledge of **Tally Prime**.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets**.
* Understanding of GST, TDS, invoicing and basic accounting principles.
* Good communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to maintain confidential financial information.
* Ability to independently follow up with customers and vendors.
* Good organisational and documentation skills.

Preferred

* Experience handling GST\-related accounting activities.
* Experience with accounts receivable and accounts payable.
* Experience with bank reconciliation.
* Experience working with a CA or external accounting team.
* Knowledge of project\-wise accounting.
* Experience in a technology/startup/company environment.

Key Performance Expectations

The person should be able to ensure that:

* **No customer payment is forgotten.**
* **No vendor payment is missed.**
* **All invoices are properly recorded.**
* **Expenses are properly documented.**
* **Bank and accounting records are regularly reconciled.**
* **Management has an accurate view of receivables, payables and cash flow.**
* **Required information reaches the CA on time.**

Career Growth

This is a full\-time position with an opportunity to grow into an **Accounts Manager / Finance Executive** role as BirdScale's operations expand.

Pay: ₹14,822\.80 \- ₹23,579\.77 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person
